title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - NetLinearReference
description: Net Linear Reference (era:NetLinearReference's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Represents a linear reference in the network. Inherits attributes from era:NetBasicReference/era:Feature (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NetLinearReference'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

endsAt.description: Relationship. Specifies the ending point of a linear reference.

hasSequence.description: Property. The ordered sequence of topological linear elements which create a linear net reference.

startsAt.description: Relationship. Specifies the starting point of a linear reference.

validity.description: Relationship. Relates a feature with a temporal feature to indicate a validity period. Target type (TemporalFeature) is not published as its own SDM model in this RINF pass.
